goal: FG-629: Name the world kind when no skeleton derives

components.summary: Unreleased code-derived bounded audit and exact-base comparison with native replay, source coverage, saved and test starts, and concise current-tree evidence; enter only through python -m flowguard.behave.
responsibilities: provide standalone pilot help that lists only implemented verbs and reject unsupported Python interpreters before loading pilot behavior
keep the pilot absent from the public CLI, exports, skill and product documentation
guard pilot source against dependence on experiment-specific application names
derive the F9 skeleton and its source identities from shared syntax and discovery facts, including shipped settings, entities, actions, queries, interface, persistence and finite worlds
initialize real source pins, print derived facts, unrecognized front doors and a glossary draft, and validate corrections without choosing settings or removing generated goals
construct and call the real program only in a fresh isolated process through the shared runner and import-path owners
observe complete supported instance graphs, shipped defaults and arena files independently of the program serializer, retaining order and shared references
restore a concrete starting recipe through public-call prefix replay and verify the full resulting observation; state unsupported roots and resources instead of reporting an empty successful world
explore each world and seed in one native process with fixed finite domains and budgets, compact coverage-guided receipts and complete focused search only within its declared slice
identify opened files, imports, listed directories, engine source and run inputs by content; reuse matching execution facts without persisting a final verdict

replay every candidate in a fresh process before reporting it, retain stable semantic identities, and reprove saved evidence against current code while distinguishing incomplete work and engine defects
observe or explicitly reject mutable class/global state touched by actual execution; do not reject unused declarations or mistake an unchanged instance graph for unchanged program state
collect bootstrap and isolation guards on Python 3.11 while collecting the named pilot behavior tests only on Python 3.12 or newer

check generated status values, successful actions, offered UI options and screens reached from home under shipped settings; before a missing-reach item replay known public witnesses, explore a second fixed seed and completely search from concrete prefixes nearest to the goal guards; a capped or incomplete domain stays unknown
explain shipped reach items with one-setting variations without clearing the shipped item; retain unbuildable and unimplemented scope instead of presenting sampling as a proof

check concrete stuck candidates only for categorical values left elsewhere; search the target entity, entities named by its actual pure one-entity queries and actions taking no entity, preserving complete state and every action answer; distinguish complete bounded no-exit proof, capped unknown and observed terminal-by-design information

record actual tests by the derived system, UI and settings types using outermost public calls, ordered public construction events and distinct session receivers; compare the shared complete snapshot at public boundaries and teardown and stop an inconsistent prefix without claiming complete Python write monitoring

replay recorded prefixes step by step on fresh shipped roots through the same native session, listing ignored test settings and stopping at the first external-edit boundary or outcome divergence; only public shipped replays with every entity kind present may witness reach, and UI reach requires sessions created at home and advanced through their public choose method

identify test recordings by test content and actual execution footprint, cache facts rather than conclusions, and print only fresh-proved implemented-check items with stable semantic identities while leaving unfinished checks and incomplete searches explicit

select the latest reachable release and one earlier release per actual native saved-data key structure; identify old source trees and persistence pins, and produce saved bytes only through each old program public construction, action and save methods using the existing isolated worker

retain old-save source revision, public input recipe, schema shape, file bytes and content identity; verify the originating version accepts each generated save, include matching committed saved-file fixtures outside tool metadata, and report missing or unsupported saved-file sources explicitly instead of inventing a successful empty set

load each saved file through the current public persistence root in a fresh native world and continue with the shared supported checks, snapshot, restore and search; retain loaded configuration and complete graph and file state, keep post-load origins distinct, and do not claim later generic checks already run

compare actual old and current loading outcomes: old acceptance followed by a new refusal is lost loading even when the message requests migration or regeneration; a refusal is designed progress only when the old side refused too, while nondeclared loading exceptions remain crashes

freshly reprove saved-file findings from their actual bytes and old-code provenance before printing stable semantic items; distinguish complete post-load no-exit evidence, capped or unsupported scope and no saved files, and keep every saved-file recipe usable by why on the current tree

derive predictor/action parameter bindings, UI offer/action correspondence, optional-argument call sites and settings serializer paths from the existing shared syntax and discovery facts; retain ambiguous mappings as unknown instead of matching application-specific names

compare each supported predictor answer and the corresponding action with identical arguments from the same complete native state; verify query purity, distinguish explicit why-not and boolean conventions, check both yes/refusal and no/success contradictions and source-bound UI predictor disagreement without treating an unrelated state as the same offer

replay the union of compact complete fresh traces and eligible actual shipped test replays under the generated one-setting variations; retain refused attempts and general query observations, batch work in the existing native session, and preserve the full validated test traces rather than selecting only shortest semantic witnesses

judge setting effects only for actually constructed and changed configurations on comparable public sequences; list each requested profile and any unbuildable, unsupported, impure, truncated, unreplayable or load-overridden configuration as not judged rather than inferring unused settings from an unchanged loaded configuration

for GC5 alone distinguish query-answer changes from action outcomes and real public saved-domain data; exclude only a settings mirror uniquely bound by the actual serializer source and verified native saved bytes, keep opaque or unbound formats explicit, and preserve the complete instance graph, files, modes and outputs for other checks including GC6

report fresh-proved CONTRADICTION and bounded ADVICE ONLY items with stable semantic ids and current-tree why recipes; keep NO OBSERVED EFFECT informational and optional-argument call-site differences in a separate nonblocking advice section, retaining missing checks and JSON fixture support limits

derive supported file-taking action inputs from the existing source AST and call bindings: actual CSV reader, named columns and required fields, converter types and available argument domains; generate one normal, extra-cell and missing-cell recipe per supported schema, retain unsupported or ambiguous formats explicitly, and use GC4 saved bytes for load-like readers

check actual fresh, eligible shipped-test and saved-start public calls for nondeclared exceptions and refusals that alter the complete instance graph, files, permission modes or shipped defaults; retain full ordered state without the GC5 settings-mirror projection and do not treat arbitrary ValueError or TypeError as declared refusals

retain each generated input name, kind and exact bytes with its public prefix and source binding; report CRASH with the actual exception type, message and application file and line, or REFUSED CHANGED STATE with the complete before/after identity, only after a fresh replay reproduces the violation

compare supported append-only output increments as multisets that retain repeated identical entries while leaving complete state container order unchanged; keep crash and refusal evidence usable by current-tree why and keep unimplemented checks and unsupported file formats explicit

compare an exact Git base source with the current working tree through the existing source export, native session and execution facts; retain dirty-tree content identities and source pins, use the same requested worlds, seeds and budgets with explicit actual shipped configurations, and do not alter either input tree or require owner declarations

report LOST only with an actual old witness that fails on current code, all applicable known witnesses replayed, a second fixed seed and a complete bounded guard-directed search that also misses; keep capped, unsupported, unbuildable or unmatched source contexts explicit rather than turning sampled differences into findings, and apply the same reach proof to new generated goals

identify new complete stuck states and source-bound contradictions only after comparing both versions under matching fresh or GC4 saved-file origins; reuse actual saved bytes and independent baseline loader acceptance, retain loaded configurations, and keep saved origins separate from fresh shipped starts

record actual per-call categorical and entity-value transitions from complete native observations and confirm NEW or LOST transitions on the other version by replaying their concrete public witnesses; if a witness action is absent use a bounded directed search from equal before-values, leaving every unconfirmed transition as coverage only

bind actual statement reach to the shared source AST and real native monitoring receipts; report still-present statements as DEAD CODE only after an old execution witness, failed current replay and complete bounded current reach checks, with exact source function, statement count and an example; ambiguous source positions or incomplete reach stay coverage rather than dead code

freshly prove each declaration-free change item and its two source identities before printing, retain semantic ids and current-tree why recipes, show world construction failures honestly, and retain the unfinished overall audit protocol for its own implementation step

include working-tree provided JSON saved-file fixtures separately from committed HEAD fixtures using the existing metadata exclusions and actual old-version public-loader acceptance; record the real input path, exact bytes and hash, untracked origin and old source footprint without inventing a public-save recipe or changing the material Git state

combine ordinary shipped audit checks and saved-file starts with optional exact-base comparison instead of replacing ordinary checks; preserve actual source identities, requested bounds and unjudged scope

probe identical eligible shipped-test prefixes for predictor agreement and crash or refusal changes once under their own complete execution footprint; reuse only content-bound facts and keep each candidate fresh proof and each world-specific check
explore eligible public test starts only in a separate audit-side run with its own corpus, budget, candidates and UI pool and retain its test-start origin without clearing shipped absence findings
derive audit coverage from actual source function and line identities, report least-covered modules and changed lines that ran or did not run, and retain unrecognised entries and incomplete checks

render audit evidence with BLOCKED CLEAR UNCHECKED or unfinished-job RUNNING from one payload; finished audits exit zero, usage errors exit two, capped or incomplete work never becomes CLEAR, and JSON is one line
explain and freshly reprove audit findings on demand against the current source with actual deciding outcomes; expose coverage and proof failures without treating stored recipes as current verdicts

when a supported executable skeleton cannot be derived or built, report the real source entries, required Calls TempProject or MACHINE world and missing input contents without executing an empty world or inventing an available API; offer only existing source-bound pin or UI corrections and retain all unjudged behavior and coverage
